clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Lights out and away we go!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Welcome to the Grand Prix! The grid is set, the engines are roaring!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Five lights, and they're gone! What a launch!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Oh, I have been waiting all week for this one! Let's race!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Into turn one, side by side! Here we go!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Brilliant start from the front row!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: He's alongside! And he's through! What a move!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Dives up the inside! Overtake complete!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Around the outside! Oh, that is brave!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: That is a textbook overtake! Late braking, perfect line!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Blue car passes Red! Into the lead!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Red car fights back! Takes the place!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Wheel to wheel! Absolutely thrilling!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Into the boost zone! Flap is open!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Boost zone activated! He's closing fast!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: He's within a second! The boost zone is his friend!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Boost zone gets him right on the gearbox!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: He's in for the pit stop!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Lightning stop! Two point two seconds!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Out of the pits, back on track!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Fantastic work from the pit crew! Perfect stop!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Slow stop! A wheel nut is stuck!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Fresh soft tires! He's flying now!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Those tires are fading fast! He needs to pit!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Smart choice going to the hard tires! They'll last forever!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Look at the grip! He's glued to the track!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Oh! He's spun off! Into the gravel!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Contact! Both cars are out!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: He's into the barrier! The driver is out and waving, he's okay!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Ooh, too much speed into that corner! The car just let go!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Safety car deployed!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The safety car is out, and the pack bunches up!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: That changes everything! Strategy time!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Safety car is in this lap! Get ready for the restart!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Yellow flag! Caution in sector two!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Red flag! The session is stopped!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Yellow flags mean no overtaking! Careful now!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Green flag! We're racing again!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Blue flags, he has to let the leader through!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Fastest lap! Purple sectors everywhere!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: He sets the fastest lap of the race!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: That is a blistering lap! On the absolute limit!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Last lap! Here we go!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: White flag! One lap to go!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Everything on the line! Push, push, push!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: One more lap, and the gap is shrinking!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Checkered flag! He wins the Grand Prix!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Across the line! Victory! What a drive!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: He takes the checkered flag! Unbelievable race!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: He drove like a champion today! Flawless!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Side by side to the line! It's a photo finish!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: By a whisker! Hundredths of a second!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Up on the podium! What a celebration!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: First, second and third! The trophies are out!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: What a day for the whole team! They deserve this!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The champagne-free celebration begins! Sparkling juice everywhere!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Not his day! He finishes off the podium!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Tough race! He'll come back stronger next time!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Listen to the fans in the grandstand!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: The whole crowd is on its feet!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Flags waving everywhere! What a scene!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Steady gap at the front, about two seconds!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: He's managing his tires, waiting to strike!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Through the chicane, nice and clean!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: You can feel an attack coming!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Plenty of laps left in this one!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: What a start from the Blue car!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Rocket launch! He gained three places!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Can he catch the leader?

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: He's a second a lap faster! It's only a matter of time!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Boost zone coming up!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: This is his big chance! Get it right on the exit!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Did you see that pit stop?

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Incredible! That crew is lightning fast!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: This crowd is amazing!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: They've been cheering since the warm-up lap!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Will his tires last?

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: It's going to be very tight! He's nursing them!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Safety car! What does this mean?

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Free pit stop for some! Strategy chaos!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: He's all over the gearbox!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: The pressure is enormous! Something's got to give!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Is that the fastest lap?

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Purple everywhere! That is sensational!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: What a move around the outside!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Brave and brilliant! That's the move of the day!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Two laps left, the gap is under a second!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Oh, this is going to the wire!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The rain is starting to fall!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Uh oh! Who'll switch to wet tires first?

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Huge save after that slide!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Amazing car control! He caught it perfectly!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The Red car is fighting back!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: He's not giving up without a battle!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Look at the sparks off the floor!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Flat out through the fast corners! Beautiful!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Is this the race of the season?

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: It's right up there! What a show!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Another overtake!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: He's carving through the field!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The lead has changed again!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Three leaders in five laps! Unbelievable!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: He's locked up!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Flat spot! That's going to hurt!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: And that's the checkered flag!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: What a race! I loved every lap!
